svg.title: Clean service beside isolated old storage
svg.desc: Continue the clean directory geometry across the chapter break, keeping old storage dark and isolated beside it. New service availability does not reopen the old instance. Visual distinction: Two capped edges with an empty interval and severed contact stubs. Containment disconnects traffic while preserving the isolated object. An archival sleeve with folded corners and a continuous custody band. Its empty center holds preserved storage separately from live traffic; no records or checksums are invented.
